remarks: Easy, comfortable, and ready to move right in! A recently renovated first-floor condo offering the perfect combination of convenience and low-maintenance living. This condo features two generously sized bedrooms with spacious closets and an updated full bathroom with a tiled shower and flooring. The beautifully refreshed kitchen offers corian countertops, updated cabinetry, and a convenient seating area. A spacious, light-filled living room provides the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing. Fresh paint, newer carpeting, and updated furnace and central air conditioning add to the home’s appeal. Additional conveniences include a private, secured storage space and coin-operated laundry facilities in the common basement, along with ample on-site parking. The HOA covers lawn care, snow removal, water, sewer, trash collection making everyday living that much easier. Ideally situated between West Seneca and Orchard Park, with convenient access to shopping, dining, and major highways.
